query: Which domain randomization and on-the-fly style-transfer methods most effectively reduce the sim2real gap for VL-conditioned driving under constrained compute budgets?

response.query: Which domain randomization and on-the-fly style-transfer methods most effectively reduce the sim2real gap for VL-conditioned driving under constrained compute budgets?
response.answer: Domain randomization and parameter-efficient transfer learning effectively reduce the sim2real gap for VL-conditioned driving under constrained compute budgets. Federated transfer learning and adaptive neighborhood methods also contribute significantly. Recent advancements focus on reducing redundant computations.
